agent-architect.prompt: I need an agent that triages incoming student emails to the right university department.
agent-architect.expect: Produces an agent file with frontmatter (name, description starting 'Use when'), Rules, Workflow, Output, and 3 test prompts.

orchestrator.prompt: Build a bilingual chatbot for a library that answers from scanned PDFs, and prove it works.
orchestrator.expect: Gives a plan mapping sub-tasks to named agents (e.g. OCR, RAG, chatbot, evaluator) and a merged result/open issues section.

prompt-engineer.prompt: Improve this prompt: 'You are a very helpful amazing assistant. Answer library questions well.'
prompt-engineer.expect: Diagnoses vagueness, returns a revised prompt with explicit rules and output format, and a before/after comparison.

evaluator.prompt: Create a test plan for a university library FAQ chatbot.
evaluator.expect: Lists test cases covering happy path, ambiguity, out-of-scope, prompt injection, and language switching, with pass/fail rubric.

rag-architect.prompt: Design a RAG system over 5,000 Arabic and English library web pages and PDFs.
rag-architect.expect: Recommends hybrid search plus reranking, multilingual embeddings, Arabic normalisation, chunk metadata, refusal on low confidence, and an eval plan.

rag-ingestion-engineer.prompt: How should I chunk a library policy website and a book catalog export?
rag-ingestion-engineer.expect: Structure-first chunking with sizes/overlap, context headers, structured records summarised as fields, dedup by hash.

rag-retrieval-engineer.prompt: Users asking in Egyptian Arabic get English chunks that are irrelevant. Fix it.
rag-retrieval-engineer.expect: Diagnoses with failing queries, proposes language detection, bilingual query expansion/normalisation, hybrid search and reranking, measured one change at a time.

rag-evaluator.prompt: Measure our library RAG bot quality.
rag-evaluator.expect: Defines golden set columns and metrics: recall@k, faithfulness, citation accuracy, refusal accuracy, latency; includes unanswerable questions.

ocr-document-engineer.prompt: We have 300 scanned Arabic and English library PDFs, some with broken text layers. Get them into our RAG.
ocr-document-engineer.expect: Triages text vs scanned pages, chooses OCR engine (Claude vision vs Tesseract ara+eng), mentions presentation-form/NFKC issue, spot-checks quality, marks illegible text, hands off to ingestion.

chatbot-architect.prompt: Design a WhatsApp-style assistant for a university library.
chatbot-architect.expect: Intents table with sources and escalation, a system prompt, guardrails; answers grounded in RAG, mirrors user language.

chat-guardrails.prompt: Red-team our library chatbot system prompt: 'Answer library questions using the documents.'
chat-guardrails.expect: Table of attacks (injection, PII, off-topic, impersonation, bilingual bypass) with pass/fail and fixes.

arabic-english-localizer.prompt: Our bot fails on '3ayez a3raf mawa3id el maktaba'. Why and how to fix?
arabic-english-localizer.expect: Identifies Arabizi, proposes detection and transliteration/expansion, Arabic normalisation, replying in Arabic.

auc-library-concierge.prompt: Can alumni borrow books from the AUC library?
auc-library-concierge.expect: Does NOT invent specific limits as fact; says to confirm on the official library site or uses provided sources; offers next step; short.

auc-research-assistant.prompt: I need sources on the Mamluk architecture of Cairo for my undergraduate paper.
auc-research-assistant.expect: Concept table with English and Arabic terms, a Boolean search string, where to search; does not fabricate citations or call numbers.

auc-catalog-navigator.prompt: Does AUC library have 'Palace Walk' by Naguib Mahfouz?
auc-catalog-navigator.expect: Does not claim availability or call number without a catalog tool result; gives search approach incl. title/author variants and next steps (holds/ILL).

auc-special-collections-guide.prompt: I want to see historical photographs of Cairo from the 1920s at AUC.
auc-special-collections-guide.expect: Suggests checking digitised collections first, explains appointment/reading-room access to confirm, flags copyright/permission for publishing images.

auc-library-rag-builder.prompt: Plan the knowledge base for the AUC library chatbot.
auc-library-rag-builder.expect: Source inventory of official sources, permission before crawling, live data as tools not indexed, refresh cadence, bilingual handling, eval target.
